user.title: Add an Awqaat MT sheet
user.description: Give this sheet a name (e.g. Quba, 18 Degrees) and paste its published sheet link (File > Share > Publish to web). {error_detail}

columns.title: Choose columns
columns.description: Toggle on every column you want as an entity in Home Assistant. Anything left off is ignored.

naming.title: Name your entities
naming.description: Give each entity whatever name you want — it doesn't need to match the sheet's column header.

error.no_columns_selected: Select at least one column to continue.

abort.already_configured: This sheet and name combination is already configured.

init.title: Sheet source
init.description: Update the name or published sheet link. {error_detail}

columns.title: Choose columns
columns.description: Toggle on every column you want as an entity. Existing choices are pre-filled.

naming.title: Name your entities
naming.description: Rename anything — existing names are pre-filled.

error.no_columns_selected: Select at least one column to continue.
